concept.subject: Five giant prize rosettes pinned to a wooden prize board, each a ring of pleated ribbon around a round button, with two tails hanging below.
concept.composition: The board's top edge runs across at a fifth of the height with the sky above it. The largest rosette hangs in the middle a little below half height, a quarter of the picture wide; two smaller ones hang high at a quarter of the height near a fifth and four fifths of the width; two more hang low at three fifths of the height at 30 and 70 percent. Each rosette's tails splay down and outward.
concept.layout: 69 round pegs and 85 bricks. Each rosette's pleated ring is a ring of curved bricks broken into short arcs, with its center button a peg ring inside; its two tails are short brick slides splaying down and out. The pins and the board's tacks are single pegs, and a row of tacks along the board's top edge sits beside the cannon.

difficulty.note: Second hardest: the buttons sit inside broken rings, and the tails throw balls toward the walls.

background.prompt: Five giant prize rosettes are pinned to a wooden prize board at a country fair. The board's top edge runs straight across the picture at about one fifth of its height, with a soft turquoise sky above it, open at the top center. Each rosette is a round ring of pleated ribbon around a flat round center button, with two ribbon tails hanging below it and splaying outward. The largest rosette hangs in the middle of the picture, centered a little below half the height, about a quarter of the picture wide; two smaller ones hang high on the left and right at about one quarter of the height and about one fifth and four fifths of the width; two more hang low on the left and right at about three fifths of the height and about 30 and 70 percent of the width. The ribbons are cream, pale teal, soft straw yellow and muted brick red. The board is pale weathered wood; the lower corners are plain board.
